name: Hercules Investments Limited
about: Hercules Investments Limited, a core investment company, engages in the investment management business in India. It holds and manages investment portfolios, as well as invests in securities of group companies. The company was formerly known as Hercules Hoists Limited and changed its name to Hercules Investments Limited in September 2025. Hercules Investments Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Mumbai, India.
